my_knob.question: Is the emerging belt lopsided in latitude: does it spread further poleward of its centre than equatorward?
my_knob.expected: r > 0 (poleward half wider). Week 3's Figure 4 showed real wings starting higher than the synthetic ones and equatorward tails thinning faster, which a symmetric band cannot do.

held_out_unit_contributed: its own events, to fit its own clock shift (drift timescale from the training fold)
protocol.declaration: Leave-one-cycle-out over the nine development cycles, both hemispheres held out together. Inside every fold the shared drift timescale, every shape parameter and a_ref come from the training wings only; the held-out wing's amplitude is predicted from the sunspot-area record through a map fitted on the training wings. Cycles 16, 20 and 22 were never touched.
